decision_requested: Should Portable Case Pack v1 execute its published Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema as the structural authority before semantic validation?

in: Portable Case Pack v1 structural validation
out: Portable Case Pack v2 claim lifecycle

observed.statement: Portable Case Pack v1 declares required fields, closed object shapes, and date-time formats in a Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema.
Before the parity fix, CI checked that the schema document was valid JSON but did not execute the schema against Portable Case Pack instances.
observed.uncertainty: This is a replay observation anchored to the pre-fix public commit.

observed.statement: Merged PR 36 added Draft 2020-12 instance validation and negative mutation coverage before semantic validation.

derived.statement: Executing the published schema before the semantic validator removes the previously observed structural-authority mismatch for the covered mutation classes.
derived.uncertainty: The statement is limited to the structural constraints and mutation classes covered by Portable Case Pack v1 and the committed tests.

judged.statement: Schema execution should remain the structural authority while the handwritten validator remains responsible for cross-field domain semantics.
judged.uncertainty: This is an architecture judgment accepted by the repository change, not proof that all future Case Pack semantics are complete.

unknown.statement: Whether every derived claim must carry at least one evidence reference remains an explicit Portable Case Pack v1 semantic-contract decision.
unknown.uncertainty: Do not silently tighten this rule inside the Case 0 replay.

strongest_counterevidence.statement: Executing a closed schema can expose compatibility failures in instances that were previously tolerated by a narrower handwritten validator.
strongest_counterevidence.impact: Treat newly rejected previously-supported shapes as compatibility findings; do not weaken the schema merely to preserve a false-ready path.

rejected_directions.direction: Keep the handwritten semantic validator as the only runtime gate
rejected_directions.reason: That path leaves published structural constraints non-authoritative and recreates the false-ready condition.

rejected_directions.direction: Use the parity repair to tighten derived-claim evidence semantics
rejected_directions.reason: That would mix structural enforcement with an unresolved contract change and would require separate compatibility review.

source_gaps: This public replay does not establish private downstream adoption or manager value.
The derived-claim evidence requirement remains intentionally unresolved in Portable Case Pack v1.
next_tool_task: Validate the Case 0 receipts against the same case identity and evidence boundary.
falsification: Reverse the recommendation if executing the published schema demonstrably rejects an intentionally valid Portable Case Pack v1 shape that the contract is required to support.

unavailable: private downstream Case Pack compatibility observations

omitted.reason: Case handoff preserves claims and evidence references rather than hidden reasoning.
